scheme_name: Government of Goa State Scholarship to NDA Cadets
other_conditions: Must be born in Goa and/or domiciled in Goa for at least 15 years.
Should not be receiving any other financial assistance, scholarship, or freeship.
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹1,000 per month for up to 24 months and a one-time outfit allowance of ₹12,000.
